caption: The drawing depicts a single iron object, an old-fashioned flat iron, placed centrally on a plain light beige or off-white background. The flat iron has a pointed, triangular base with dark brown and black shading, suggesting it is made of metal. The iron features a rounded handle, which appears twisted or ribbed in texture, and is joined to the base by two upright supports. The colors used in the drawing are primarily shades of brown and gray, giving a realistic and metallic appearance to the iron. The surface of the iron shows tonal variation, indicating highlights and shadows. In the lower right corner of the drawing, the artist's signature "ARINGTON GREGG" is visible in small, capitalized letters. There are a few small orange-brown spots scattered on the lower left part of the background.
title: Iron
